1239|c86281a7.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
1239|c86281a7.text: If you're willing to endure tales that will shiver your timbers and sog your skivvies, then get yourself a drink and sit for a spell...

1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken... for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

1317|f472d1d3.name: Lucan Cordell
1317|f472d1d3.text: A true professional know his limitations, and I'm not ashamed to admit that your skills exceed mine. I want you to pay a visit to Kitta Firewind at the Tower of Azora. She is well-renowned, and with good reason.

1321|877c4b1d.name: Alyssa Griffith
1321|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1325|e69bef2b.name: Jasper Fel
1325|e69bef2b.text: Speak quietly and with great care, the wrong word in these parts could get your throat cut. Now, what is it you need from me?

1347|23d8b931.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1464|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Helbrek
1464|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1480|4d61ac25.name: Caitlin Grassman
1480|4d61ac25.text: Alchemy can help so many people! It's my life's passion.

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1719|bf4c7bb7.name: Warden Thelwater
1719|bf4c7bb7.text: Over here, you worthless...! If you want to do something useful, listen quick!

2094|28b1f157.name: James Halloran
2094|28b1f157.text: Greetings, $c. I'm in a bit of a pinch right now, running very low on hides.

2104|fe329646.name: Captain Stoutfist
2104|fe329646.text: Menethil Harbor enjoys a bit of peace these days, thanks to the mountaineers.  But we must be ever watchful of new threats from our enemies.

2327|2957a3a0.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2489|6e89a35a.name: Milstaff Stormeye
2489|6e89a35a.text: As a $c, you are one of a select group that can conjure a portal to transport you back to this very place.  I can teach you if you are ready.

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256438|43fe93cc.name: Halligan Turner
256438|43fe93cc.text: Ah, nothing beats the smell of fresh air with a hint of sweet sap.

256734|edaae191.name: Daniel Stitchsong
256734|edaae191.text: Hello there! I've got the finest leathers this side of Stormwind. Interested?

257087|424bc3ca.name: Gretchen Mayberry
257087|424bc3ca.text: Need a lift? Our gryphons are always ready to take to the skies.

257558|f35dbc79.name: Demar Brant
257558|f35dbc79.text:
Ah, it's been some time since we've had adventurers roam these halls. Welcome to Farholde Keep. Enjoy these comforts while you can. I'm sure you've seen the conditions we're forced to keep.

It seems every day we lose more of our home to the ever-growing infestation of Horde mongrels and Light-forsaken Twilight's Hammer cultists. With those cowards in Stormwind hiding behind their walls, we are forced to bring order to these beasts ourselves.

Perhaps you'd like to put some of those $c talents to use?

257591|3e0f5f68.name: Ashe Amberhall
257591|3e0f5f68.text:
When these lands fell to the orcish Horde during the First War, the bulk of the Alliance military moved on to other concerns. They believed the land lost, and that the war efforts were better spent on the home front.

We agree. But the Riverglades are our home, $N. Without aid from the rest of the army, the cavalry men and women of Farholde mounted a bold campaign to retake our lands. Under the command of Demar, we know that someday these lands will belong to us once again. 

This is not just a battle for control, $N. This is a war for our birthright.

257591|a0cd4ece.name: Ashe Amberhall
257591|a0cd4ece.text: Greetings, $c. As advisor to Demar, I would be happy to answer any questions you have about Farholde Keep.

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

270637|3e0b4d08.name: Howin Kindfeather
270637|3e0b4d08.text: So many Wildhammer lives lost... whole families erased...

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

3649|17d06d6c.name: Thundris Windweaver
3649|17d06d6c.text: Dark forces encroach upon our borders, ancient taints resurface, and new evils emerge to topple the delicate balance of the land. In times of such darkness, we all must be vigilant.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

5498|9c6df40b.name: Elsharin
5498|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

5564|30b7493c.name: Simon Tanner
5564|30b7493c.text: Sorry, but you've reached the limit of what I can teach. If you want to learn more, go see Telonis in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. He's pretty talented, so I hear.

5564|568f7020.name: Simon Tanner
5564|568f7020.text: Hmm, I guess I can take on another student. Well, don't just stand there. Tell me what you're looking to learn.

5565|877c4b1d.name: Jillian Tanner
5565|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5694|f9a7a324.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
5694|f9a7a324.text: The flow of magic is unpredictable and chaotic, of late. What, I wonder, could be the cause of this?

928|837f02f9.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

115-accept.name: Marshal Marris
115-accept.text:
The Blackrock orcs enlisted shadowcasters to aid their attacks in Redridge, and they have brought with them devices of dark power--midnight orbs.  These orbs have struck telling blows against Redridge's defenders, and it's imperative we remove the demon-tainted items from the conflict.

Find and deliver to me midnight orbs from slain Blackrock shadowcasters.  I will then have them disposed of, for this world would be a better place without them!
115-accept.title: Shadow Magic

1275-accept.name: Gershala Nightwhisper
1275-accept.text:
Foolish blood elves toil with demonic magic. Have they not witnessed what happened with the naga and with the satyrs of Kalimdor?

I fear that the blood elves will meet a similar deformation. Azeroth cannot afford to give birth to another vile race of monsters.

I wish to study the brain stems of the satyr and naga so that I might deduce what fate the elves are headed toward. In Blackfathom Deeps, on the coast of Ashenvale, you will find both satyr and naga.

'Tis a long journey, $N.
1275-accept.title: Researching the Corruption

148-accept.name: Abercrombie
148-accept.text:
Oh, what is a poor old man to do?  I need some supplies from Darkshire, but the village is so far away and I am so old and feeble...I would never make the trip.

Can you go to Darkshire and bring me back some Ghost Hair Thread?  You can get it from Madame Eva at her home on the Darkshire square.
148-accept.title: Supplies from Darkshire

148-complete.name: Madame Eva
148-complete.text: Ah, Ghost Hair Thread is what you need, is it?  I'm afraid I have none in stock, but I can make some for you...if you can supply the ghost hair.
148-complete.title: Supplies from Darkshire

149-accept.name: Madame Eva
149-accept.text:
There is a poor, sad spirit, Blind Mary, who haunts an old farm house in the hills south of Darkshire.

Here, take this Spectral Comb and ask Blind Mary to comb her hair.  Then bring back the comb and I will glean from it the Ghost Hair I'll need for the thread.

And take care, for dark things now lurk near that house...
149-accept.title: Ghost Hair Thread

163-complete.name: Jitters
163-complete.text: No! Please don't kill me! It's just me... Jitters!! They're everywhere... I can't escape them! Monsters in Raven Hill? N-n-n-o... couldn't be. Only harmless Jitters.
163-complete.title: Raven Hill

164-complete.name: Sven Yorgen
164-complete.text: These supplies will be most useful. The aid of the Carevin family is always appreciated. Here is a little something for your trouble.
164-complete.title: Deliveries to Sven

164-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
164-progress.text: You look a sturdy type, $c. Have you come to join our fight?
164-progress.title: Deliveries to Sven

165-complete.name: Abercrombie
165-complete.text:
Elaine Carevin? Hehe, oh yes... of course, the Carevins.

No, nothing's wrong but it is hard for me to go into town now. The roads are dangerous and I'm not getting any younger. Maybe you can do an old man some favors?
165-complete.title: The Hermit

173-accept.name: Calor
173-accept.text:
Darkness seems drawn inexorably to Duskwood. Master Carevin's quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy. Through our efforts are the people of Darkshire kept safe.

You believe yourself worthy to join us?

I once thought as you. Disillusioned by the complacency of the Watch, I joined Master Carevin. If you wish to prove yourself, it will not be through words.

Test your skills against the Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen in Brightwood Grove--bright, hah!--and the Rotting Orchard.
173-accept.title: Worgen in the Woods

180-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-complete.text: So the evil Lieutenant Fangore is dead?  Good riddance to that foul creature.  You are very brave, $c.  The Township of Lakeshire thanks you for your aid.
180-complete.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

180-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-progress.text: What news do you bring before the Court?
180-progress.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

19-accept.name: Marshal Marris
19-accept.text: Blackrock Outrunners and Renegades are running ambushes between here and Stonewatch Keep.  The leader of the Outrunners is an orc named Tharil'zun--we want this orc.  Bring me the head of Tharil'zun!
19-accept.title: Tharil'zun

20-complete.name: Marshal Marris
20-complete.text: That makes for a lot fewer orcs to worry about, thanks.
20-complete.title: Blackrock Menace

20-progress.name: Marshal Marris
20-progress.text: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20-progress.title: Blackrock Menace

226-accept.name: Lars
226-accept.text:
Sven and I have dangerous days ahead of us, what with the Necromancer to the east and all.  And out here alone as we are, we have to hunt for our own food.  It seems every time I'm heading back to camp with some meat on me, starving or rabid dire wolves come out of the forest wanting a bite.  It goes without saying, living out here is dangerous work!

But if you can rid us of some of those wolves, we'd have an easier time of it.  They mostly prowl north and east of here, near the river.
226-accept.title: Wolves at Our Heels

226-complete.name: Lars
226-complete.text:
Oh good.  You thinned out that pack quite a bit, and without those wolves nipping out our heels, we can bind our minds to dealing with Morbent Fel.

Here, take some of these Flash Bundles.  They make them in town, and a lot have been donated to Sven to help with his cause.
226-complete.title: Wolves at Our Heels

245-complete.name: Watcher Dodds
245-complete.text: Ah! You're back. And not too much worse for wear, it'd seem. Of course, $N, the Night Watch is grateful for your work, and I did promise you a reward, so here.
245-complete.title: Eight-Legged Menaces

2745-complete.name: Tyrion
2745-complete.text:
What the...?! Don't sneak up on me like that! And keep your voice down! What in the name of the Shadow are you doing sneakin' up on me for? Can't you see I'm busy, you daft fool?

What do you mean, what am I doing? I'm waiting for the next Dark Portal to open, what the heck do you think I'm doing? Speak your peace and be off with you... 'fore the guards notice the two of us hiding in the bushes together. I have a reputation to maintain.
2745-complete.title: Infiltrating the Castle

2746-accept.name: Tyrion
2746-accept.text:
Trias wants the timetable pushed up some, huh? Okay, we can do that, but I'm not ready. And know this, I'm doing the hard part, but you're the one that's going to get his hands dirty, understand? Good.

Okay, I'll need you to get me a few things before I can put my plan into effect. I got the perfect disguise that'll get Spybot past those guards.

Bring me some silk and a couple apples. The silk's up to you, but Clara's little farm right outside the city has the perfect sized apples.
2746-accept.title: Items of Some Consequence

275-accept.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
275-accept.text:
I do not know why, but a festering grows within the Wetlands. Fen Creepers have risen. They are diseased, fevered blisters on the land, and for the fever to break they must be dispatched and allowed to settle back into the marshes.

The Fen Creepers shamble amidst the waterways of the Wetlands.
275-accept.title: Blisters on the Land

276-accept.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
276-accept.text:
The Mosshide Gnolls have lived in the Wetlands peacefully for many years, but now grow in numbers. Their feet stamp flat the fen's bushes and flowers, and their foul axes cut too much wood to fuel their fires.

They are no longer in balance with the land. For the Wetlands to survive, the Gnolls must be reduced.

Kill 15 Mosshide Gnolls and 10 Mosshide Mongrels. Hunt them to the south, near the Dwarven gate of Algaz. After you do this, return to me.
276-accept.title: Tramping Paws

276-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
276-complete.text: By reducing the gnolls' numbers, you have tended to the health of the Wetlands. Although my faith in your people has been taxed in the past, $r, it may yet be restored.
276-complete.title: Tramping Paws

277-accept.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
277-accept.text:
The Mosshides are cutting the trees of the Wetlands, using the trees' flesh to warm themselves with fire. I will suffer this pain no longer!

Rid the Mosshides of their crude flints, the tools they use to make fire. The flints are borne by all Mosshides except the smaller Mosshide gnolls and Mosshide mongrels.
277-accept.title: Fire Taboo

277-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
277-complete.text: ... thank you. I will smash these flints and cast them into the sea, so that they may never again be used to burn living wood.
277-complete.title: Fire Taboo

277-progress.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
277-progress.text: Do you have the Gnolls' tools for fire?
277-progress.title: Fire Taboo

279-accept.name: Karl Boran
279-accept.text:
Murlocs are crawling out from the deep waters and building their villages on the coastline.  They are harassing our fishers and merchants and must be stopped.

One of these Murlocs, Gobbler, skulks with other Bluegill Murlocs and harries merchants along the road, always then retreating to the safety of the nearby Murloc hovels.  Our merchants are in jeopardy, and we will pay to secure them.

Gobbler prowls the river inlet north of here.  Find him, slay his kin, and bring me his head.
279-accept.title: Claws from the Deep

279-complete.name: Karl Boran
279-complete.text:
Ah, well done $N.

Accept this as payment for fulfillment of your contract with the Merchant Marines.
279-complete.title: Claws from the Deep

279-progress.name: Karl Boran
279-progress.text: Our merchants will not be safe until we are rid of Gobbler and those Murlocs.
279-progress.title: Claws from the Deep

281-accept.name: Karl Boran
281-accept.text:
Not long ago a merchant vessel, the Blind Princess, was raided by Murlocs.  Although the ship escaped intact, much of its cargo was dragged overboard by the creatures, including a very valuable statuette of Terenas Menethil.  We want that statuette recovered.

Search the coastal Murloc hovels for crates, barrels and other evidence of lost cargo.  Find the Menethil Statuette and return it to me.
281-accept.title: Reclaiming Goods

281-complete.name: Unknown
281-complete.text:
This crate is covered with clawed scratches, and the marks of water damage.  Prying it open reveals soggy and rotted straw, as if something of value was stored in the crate.  You search through the straw...

...and find an armload of red-colored bottles.
281-complete.title: Reclaiming Goods

284-accept.name: Unknown
284-accept.text:
You thoroughly search this cluster of Murloc hovels, and find no trace of the Menethil Statuette.

Perhaps one of the two nearby hovels to the north and northeast will have more clues.
284-accept.title: The Search Continues

284-complete.name: Unknown
284-complete.text:
This barrel is largely untouched.  Prying it open...

...you are assaulted by the pungent odor of cheese.  It's a little wet, but still tasty!
284-complete.title: The Search Continues

285-accept.name: Unknown
285-accept.text:
This grouping of Murloc hovels, after a thorough inspection, reveals nothing.

...but you're certain that the next clue you find will be fruitful.

One of the hovels to the north must have the Menethil Statuette!
285-accept.title: Search More Hovels

285-complete.name: Unknown
285-complete.text: This barrel is halfway buried amidst the mud and grass ...
285-complete.title: Search More Hovels

286-accept.name: Unknown
286-accept.text:
After pulling the barrel free from the muck and opening it, a silvery figurine is found packed in fine straw.  It depicts a young, long-haired Paladin with hammer upraised.

This must be the Menethil Statuette!  You must now return it to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.
286-accept.title: Return the Statuette

286-complete.name: Karl Boran
286-complete.text:
The captain of the Blind Princess will be relieved to hear this precious cargo has been recovered.  You have well earned this payment for services rendered.

It is good to see dependable folk like you, especially in trying times such as these.
286-complete.title: Return the Statuette

288-accept.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
288-accept.text:
I was once First Mate on the Wave Mistress, ship-of-the-line in the Kul Tiras Third Fleet. The Doomed Fleet. Doomed, for on its last voyage the fleet was attacked by Red Dragons. Dragons controlled by Orcs!

We didn't stand a chance against that dragonfire...and our fleet was burned and sunk off this here coast. I'm the sole survivor of those poor vessels...

...Oh, my head hammers and pounds! I'll need a fresh drink if I'm to get a handle on this hangover and continue my tale.
288-accept.title: The Third Fleet

288-complete.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
288-complete.text: Ah! That hits the spot, and loosens the tongue. Thanks, mate!
288-complete.title: The Third Fleet

288-progress.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
288-progress.text: Oh, I'm so very thirsty! Won't you buy a drink for this poor, pathetic fool?
288-progress.title: The Third Fleet

289-accept.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
289-accept.text:
<Bolstered, Fitzsimmons continues his tale...>

I am the sole survivor of the ill-fated Third Fleet of Kul Tiras, wrecked off the coast to the north. But although I'm the only member of the fleet still breathing, I'm not the only one still walking about! For on one of our ships was hidden a great, and terrible treasure, and the eerie power of it keeps the souls of my brothers trapped within the ships' rotting hulls.

But if you can free some of my brothers, then perhaps you can break their curse.
289-accept.title: The Cursed Crew

294-accept.name: Ormer Ironbraid
294-accept.text:
The situation is severe, that much is for sure. When we uncovered these bones it attracted the Raptors. These filthy beasts killed my brethren and trapped me, Merrin and the poor Prospector up here.

Help clear the Wetlands of these Raptors, $N. Mottled Raptors and Mottled Screechers are just West of the bluff there. Kill 10 of each, if you can.

That will be a good start to the vengeance I have planned for them.
294-accept.title: Ormer's Revenge

294-complete.name: Ormer Ironbraid
294-complete.text: Killing is a dirty business, but you did your job well, $N. If I weren't obligated to stay with the Prospector and Merrin, I'd be down there shedding blood right along side you.
294-complete.title: Ormer's Revenge

295-accept.name: Ormer Ironbraid
295-accept.text: Now it's time to really make those dreaded Raptors regret their blood-thirst. Just down below there are scores of Mottled Scytheclaws and Mottled Razormaws. Make those rotten creatures pay by slaying 10 of each!
295-accept.title: Ormer's Revenge

295-complete.name: Ormer Ironbraid
295-complete.text: You did a bang-up job of clearing out those raptors, $N!
295-complete.title: Ormer's Revenge

296-accept.name: Ormer Ironbraid
296-accept.text:
While you were down there I happened to notice that one of those beasts stood out from the rest. He was bigger and more menacing. I bet he's the one who led the others here to cause the disruption to the dig site.

I ask of you now one final task, $N. See to it that Sarltooth is brought to justice. And considering the gravity of his crimes, justice in this case means death! Bring me one of his talons as proof of his death.
296-accept.title: Ormer's Revenge

296-complete.name: Ormer Ironbraid
296-complete.text: Thank you, $N. Your efforts here will not be forgotten. Many innocent Dwarves died at this site, simply doing their jobs. The vengeance you delivered to those evil creatures should make them think twice before attacking King Magni's subjects ever again.
296-complete.title: Ormer's Revenge

296-progress.name: Ormer Ironbraid
296-progress.text: Is Sarltooth dead? Have you redeemed the memory of the fallen?
296-progress.title: Ormer's Revenge

299-accept.name: Prospector Whelgar
299-accept.text:
Just before the invasion I uncovered a large tablet called the Goaz Stone. The translated text breaks off in 4 places. The text speaks of a "divine plan" and a "doomed prophecy."

I fear we are running out of time. I am too old to go down and brave those beasts. But you are strong.

Scour the excavation site and uncover the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru. Search for them in ancient artifacts or where the soil is loose. Bring them to me so I can begin unlocking the mystery!
299-accept.title: Uncovering the Past

299-complete.name: Prospector Whelgar
299-complete.text: Ah the Goaz Stone is complete! Fine work, $N. Fine work indeed. Now I can continue with the delicate translation of this Titan script. I can make out new words already! Hmm...it says here, "Old Gods... Chained Beneath the Land." This is the beginning of something epic.
299-complete.title: Uncovering the Past

299-progress.name: Prospector Whelgar
299-progress.text: Have you uncovered the four fragments yet, $N?  Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru...
299-progress.title: Uncovering the Past

305-accept.name: Tarrel Rockweaver
305-accept.text:
You cannot imagine how worried I have been.

My wife, Merrin, has been sending me letters each week for the past month. She is part of the Whelgar Excavation team. But it has been nearly two weeks since her last correspondence. Surely something is wrong!

Longbraid said that he would send a scout to check up on things if we did not hear from the team soon. I assume that scout is you, $N. Find Merrin at the excavation site to the east!
305-accept.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

305-complete.name: Merrin Rockweaver
305-complete.text: Oh, thank the heavens you are here!
305-complete.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

306-accept.name: Merrin Rockweaver
306-accept.text:
It was horrible! We were uncovering some rare artifacts and we began to discover these large bones.

Before we knew what was happening, these Mottled Raptors overwhelmed the dig site. Many lives were lost.

Ormer here -- so brave -- saved the Prospector and me. He defended us as we ran for shelter. Now we are trapped. And our hard work lies in ruin.

Here, take this note back to my sweet Tarrel. It will explain the situation to him.
306-accept.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

306-complete.name: Tarrel Rockweaver
306-complete.text: Such horrible news! At least 3 of them survived. But when will the killing end? I long for the day when King Magni's subjects can live without fear.
306-complete.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

306-progress.name: Tarrel Rockweaver
306-progress.text: Were you able to find Merrin? Did she send word?
306-progress.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

343-complete.name: Milton Sheaf
343-complete.text: Metallurgy?  Ah yes, we have many books on the subject, and are happy to aid Brother Kristoff with his speech!  Now...which particular book was it the good brother needed?
343-complete.title: Speaking of Fortitude

344-accept.name: Milton Sheaf
344-accept.text:
The Stresses of Iron?  Yes, I know the book.  Quite a good one, written by the Dwarven miner Margulf Blaggon a few decades ago.  He spent most his time deep in the mountains of Khaz Modan, digging ore.  Smart fellow!

But where was I?  Oh yes, the Stresses of Iron!  I'm afraid the book was moved to the Northshire Abbey.  The caretaker of the Abbey's library, Brother Paxton, wanted to make a copy of the book for his own shelves.

But that was months ago.  I wonder why it's taking him so long...
344-accept.title: Brother Paxton

347-accept.name: Foreman Oslow
347-accept.text:
Rethban Ore is named after the man who first found it, Bart Rethban.  When smelted it's not as strong as iron, but its ore has a dark, flat color that some scribes use in their dyes.  It can be found in the Rethban Caverns, north of here.

We usually have some in stock, but we're too busy preparing for Orc attacks to gather any.  And besides...Redridge Gnolls are now living in the Rethban Caverns and their Drudgers are gathering the ore themselves.

So if you need some, you'll have to get it yourself.
347-accept.title: Rethban Ore

377-accept.name: Councilman Millstipe
377-accept.text:
As if the neglect for the residents of Duskwood was not bad enough, now the House of Nobles spits in the eye of the Darkshire Council with their decision to imprison Dextren Ward in Stormwind rather than behead the villain as per Lord Ebonlocke's sentence.

Ward was caught selling bodies from the cemetery to Morbent Fel, a crime punishable by death.  Yet Stormwind claims Ward as their prisoner.

Assassinate Ward in The Stormwind Stockade - bring me his hand - and I shall reward you.
377-accept.title: Crime and Punishment

386-accept.name: Guard Berton
386-accept.text:
Targorr the Dread served under Gath'Ilzogg as supreme Executioner.  His methods were ruthless, even by filthy orc standards.  Men who fought bravely to defend the Kingdom were tortured on his whim.  Now he is being held in the Stormwind Stockade, sentenced to die.  Yet something is amiss.  One of the bureaucratic nobles put a hold on his execution.  I am sure foul play is in the works.

Put an end to Targorr the Dread, $N.  Travel to The Stockade and behead him before trickery is upon us.
386-accept.title: What Comes Around...

387-accept.name: Warden Thelwater
387-accept.text:
The uprising must be quelled!  I need your assistance.  If word gets out that the prison is overrun I will lose my job!  This is a case of foul play if I've ever seen one.  But what's important now is forcing these prisoners into submission for the safety of Stormwind.

The punishment for insurgency is death.  Kill some of these deviants!  That ought to get things under control.
387-accept.title: Quell the Uprising

463-accept.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
463-accept.text:
You've heard of the Greenwarden? You're not looking for him, are you? Well I say you're crazy if you are, but who am I to keep a fool from his death?

If you are seeking that beast, then I hear he is in the marsh, east of the road where it forks to Dun Modr. He's lurking there among the crocs...and worse!

And leave your money here. You won't need it where you're going...and you don't want to chip ol' Greenie's tooth on your gold when he bites you in half, do you?
463-accept.title: The Greenwarden

463-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
463-complete.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one.  Although I have many names, I answer to only a few.  But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken...for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.
463-complete.title: The Greenwarden

464-accept.name: Captain Stoutfist
464-accept.text:
The Dragonmaw orc clan was all but destroyed by the end of the Second War, after they lost control of their red dragon pets. The dragons were not very happy with their old masters, and fiercely hunted the Dragonmaws. What few remained fled from Grim Batol and into the Mountains east of Whelgar's Excavation.

Now they've gained strength, and have an encampment northeast of Menethil.

We want you to attack that encampment. Gather and bring me their war banners as proof.
464-accept.title: War Banners

470-accept.name: Sida
470-accept.text:
On my weekly visit to Ironbeard's Tomb I was attacked by dreadful, dripping oozes! Naturally, I panicked.

I threw my bag at one, but it didn't do anything! The ooze just sucked it right up... Luckily, it did give me enough time to get away.

The bad news is that I really need to get the contents of my bag!

I don't know which ooze I threw my bag at; they all looked the same! Ironbeard's Tomb is northeast of here, near Dun Modr. Thank you so much!
470-accept.title: Digging Through the Ooze

470-complete.name: Sida
470-complete.text:
Oh, thank you, $N! I was afraid that it was lost for good!

<She quickly empties the contents of the ooze-covered bag onto the ground, before scooping them up.>

Hm, I don't have much use for this anymore, but wash it off and I'm sure you could make use of it.
470-complete.title: Digging Through the Ooze

471-accept.name: James Halloran
471-accept.text:
I sent my apprentice out into the marshes to skin some of our famous giant Wetlands crocolisks. When he didn't return, I went out to look for him... Let's just say it wasn't a pretty sight.

Midwife says he might pull through, but in the meantime I still need my skins!

...If you'd like to kill a few more of the brutes, I wouldn't be opposed, after what they did. You'll find the crocs north up the coast, beyond the murloc hovels.
471-accept.title: Apprentice's Duties

472-accept.name: Harlo Barnaby
472-accept.text:
Dun Modr has fallen to the Dark Iron Dwarves!

My wounds are grave, $c.  Most of the regiment was killed!  The Dark Iron thugs attacked us before we could regroup from the Thandol Span ambush.

Our leader, Longbraid, sounded the retreat horn.  As we left the town I was hit by a stray axe in the back.  All went black.

I awoke here in Menethil but I fear for my fellow soldiers.  Hope still burns within me.  Perhaps Longbraid is still alive!  See if you can find him near Dun Modr, $r!
472-accept.title: Fall of Dun Modr

484-accept.name: James Halloran
484-accept.text:
I'm James Halloran, the tanner. My cured crocolisk skins are sought after all over, shipments leaving by boat to ports around the world.

Met Einar? He's one of the hunters that brings crocolisk skins in for me.

I'm a bit short on the softer skins that come off crocolisk young.

Being that I'm running low, I'll pay you top coin for a stack of the skins. You can find the young crocs in the waters right outside of town.
484-accept.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

484-complete.name: James Halloran
484-complete.text: Nice work you've done here, $N. The quality of these skins is superb. I'll have to get them into the curing process as soon as possible. Oh, but before I get to that, there's some other work I need done that I think you might be able to take care of.
484-complete.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

484-progress.name: James Halloran
484-progress.text: $N, right? Do you have my skins?
484-progress.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

5-accept.name: Jitters
5-accept.text:
I've been stuck hiding in this ghost town for weeks, and I haven't eaten anything but grubs and weeds!  I need some decent food, and I'm willing to trade well for it.

Bring me a feast and I'll pay you handsomely.

I heard Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire makes very good Dusky Crab Cakes...
5-accept.title: Jitters' Growling Gut

5-complete.name: Chef Grual
5-complete.text: You need some Crab Cakes, do you?  Well I might be able to cook some up for you...
5-complete.title: Jitters' Growling Gut

66-accept.name: Madame Eva
66-accept.text:
Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins.  I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger.  I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.

After taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery.  A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.

Seek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character.  I fear for us all.
66-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

66-complete.name: Clerk Daltry
66-complete.text: Ah so Madame Eva sent you. . . .
66-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

67-accept.name: Clerk Daltry
67-accept.text:
Stalvan, eh?  Let me check the town registry.

Stalvan. . .Stalvan. . .let's see.  Ah, here we go!  I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle.  The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse.  My, talk about outdated!

Do me a favor will you, friend?  If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow.  I like to keep the records clean.
67-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

91-complete.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-complete.text: The Court of Lakeshire recognizes your commitment to justice, $N.  By enforcing the laws of the Kingdom you have helped uphold the justice of the land.
91-complete.title: Solomon's Law

91-progress.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-progress.text: Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
91-progress.title: Solomon's Law

93-accept.name: Chef Grual
93-accept.text:
I'll let you in on a little secret - Dusky "Crab" Cakes are really made from spider legs!  I know it's a bit disgusting, but the cakes have a nice, tangy flavor and make great snacks!  Bring me Gooey Spider Legs and I'll whip you up a few of them.

I hear Venom Web Spiders are a good source - they nest to the north, between the foothills and the river.
93-accept.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

95-accept.name: Sven Yorgen
95-accept.text:
I used to work one of the farms to the southeast...until Dark Riders from Deadwind Pass descended upon my farm and slaughtered my family when I was away!

When I returned I saw a shadowy figure skulking near my barn, burying something.  He fled before I could catch him, and I couldn't linger for I was hot on the heels of the Dark Riders.  So I never discovered what was hidden.

If you can find what that shadowy figure buried, I would be grateful.  The hiding spot is behind the old stump near my barn.
95-accept.title: Sven's Revenge

96139-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-progress.text: Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.
96139-progress.title: The Valor Family

98189-progress.name: Captain Stoutfist
98189-progress.text: What's that you've got there? Let me take a look.
98189-progress.title: Return the Statuette

98190-progress.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
98190-progress.text: Let us speak, $c. I can feel you carry something of the Light.
98190-progress.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-progress.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98191-progress.text: Light be with you, $c. You are clearly not here for small talk--what is it?
98191-progress.title: A Friend of the Family

98197-progress.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-progress.text: Keep your wits about you beneath the waves. There's plenty of nasties down there!
98197-progress.title: Spoils of War

98208-progress.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98208-progress.text: Have you been to the wreckage? It is a most somber sight.
98208-progress.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98209-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
98209-progress.text: I welcome you to Auberdine, $c. How may we be of aid to you in your travels?
98209-progress.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98282-progress.name: Caitlin Grassman
98282-progress.text: Have you had any luck? I know it's a pain to ask, but I really do need a whole gland!
98282-progress.title: Alchemical Hazards

98387-progress.name: Marshal Marris
98387-progress.text: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
98387-progress.title: Blackrock Blockade
